notes.title: The Firm Mini Update 1.02
notes.content:
[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]

*  Fixed bug in intro mission where the target civilian would not spawn if an Npc opened the cell door beforehand, breaking the tutorial event.

*  Deleted doubled-up grid square in elevators.

*  Main scene tutorial panel material changed to transparent as it was obscuring too much player vision.

*  Increased player Level 1 speed as grid movement during beginning missions was too slow and slightly too arduous.

*  Fixed bug where entering the outfitter menu would display a negative equipment tier, therefore not not displaying any equipment initially. 


Finally, Happy New Year and merry Christmas to all.  Wishing everyone peace in their hearts for 2024.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
*  Fixed spatial audio settings for npc grunts and bullet impacts.
*  Added game icons.

notes.title: The Firm Begins Its Life
notes.content:
Hi Folks,

I'm happy to announce the release of a little turn-based shooter called The Firm.  So grab your guns, use some tactics and start pew-pewing.

As player feedback comes in, there will be updates every month to adjust, fix & enhance gameplay.   

May it be bug free and fun for all.
